name: 8839-specdecode-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, one GPU of an a3 node, at tp=1.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1, draft TP=1. One in-process engine.
architecture: Target LlamaForCausalLM, 32 layers, 32 query and 32 KV heads (MHA), hidden 4096, float16, 6.74B params; draft LlamaForCausalLM, 2 layers, hidden 768, ~68M, loaded at the target's dtype. Vocab is 32000 on both, which a draft/target pair requires.
load_profile: concurrent (CLOSED loop), streams=64, bounded at 1280 requests / 1800 s safety, warmup 0.10, cooldown 0.10.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Exactly 550 prompt tokens and exactly 150 output tokens per request (min == max == nominal on both), greedy at temperature 0.0; guidellm implements the fixed output length as max_tokens=150 with ignore_eos=True, so every request does the same number of decode steps.
purpose: A 7B chat assistant with a small draft model, answering 64 concurrent fixed-length prompts on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine command line for the commit pinned in setupcard.md. Interpreter and hardware seal:
# configs/env.yaml (per-machine, NOT portable).
#
# 0.6.3-era V0 AsyncEngineArgs: an unknown key is a TypeError at engine construction. Do not add
# or rename keys from a later vLLM -- the flat speculative flags below are the only form this
# engine accepts.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-chat-hf
speculative-model: JackFram/llama-68m
num-speculative-tokens: 5
speculative-draft-tensor-parallel-size: 1

# The draft checkpoint tops out at 2048 positions and the target at 4096; the pair must agree.
max-model-len: 2048
speculative-max-model-len: 2048

tensor-parallel-size: 1
enforce-eager: true

# Mandatory, not preferences: config.py raises on either when speculative decoding is configured.
use-v2-block-manager: true
enable-chunked-prefill: false

enable-prefix-caching: false
max-num-seqs: 256
max-num-batched-tokens: 2048
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
dtype: float16
